class.name: GameplayCueQueue
class.brief_description: A bounded, priority-aware queue for cosmetic Gameplay Cue events.
class.description: Queues transient [code]executed[/code] cues and persistent [code]started[/code], [code]updated[/code], and [code]stopped[/code] lifecycle events. Inspired by Gameplay Cues in Unreal Engine GAS, this class separates visual/sound dispatch from authoritative combat. The caller is responsible for replicating authoritative state, choosing effects and draining events. Tags must start with [code]GameplayCue.[/code]. A queue stores up to 128 active tags and 128 undrained events. Repeated pending events of the same tag and type coalesce, with counts capped at 32. Higher-priority events drain first; events with equal priority retain insertion order. Each call to [method take_events] returns at most 32 events. When the queue is full, a more important transient effect may replace the oldest lowest-priority transient event. Lifecycle events ([code]started[/code], [code]updated[/code], [code]stopped[/code]) are never evicted by this policy. No cue can grant an ability or change network-authoritative state.

method.name: emit_cue
method.description: Queues one transient cue. Identical tag/event pairs are aggregated; priority is 0 to 7 and magnitude is a finite nonnegative value no greater than one million. Invalid input is rejected without mutation. If the queue is full, a new transient can replace the oldest lowest-priority transient only when its own priority is strictly higher. Repeated tags still coalesce without eviction. Lifecycle events are never candidates. Otherwise returns false without changing pending events.

method.name: emit_cues_batch
method.description: Atomically queues up to 32 transient [code]executed[/code] Gameplay Cues in one native call. Each entry must be a Dictionary with a valid [code]tag[/code] (String or StringName starting with [code]GameplayCue.[/code]), a numeric finite [code]magnitude[/code] in [code]0..1000000[/code], and an integer [code]priority[/code] in [code]0..7[/code]. All entries are checked before mutation. Existing per-event coalescing, 128-pending capacity, duplicate count cap, significance eviction and persistent lifecycle protection remain identical to [method emit_cue]. If any validated event cannot be admitted, no transient is queued, no existing event is evicted and diagnostic counters are restored. An empty batch is a successful no-op. The queue does not execute any visual or gameplay logic; the caller drains events with [method take_events].

method.name: set_active
method.description: Sets one persistent cue stack count. Zero stops the cue. Unchanged stacks do not enqueue another event; active and pending state are updated atomically.

method.name: replace_active
method.description: Transactionally applies a snapshot of tag to integer stack count, emitting only changes. Malformed input or insufficient pending capacity leaves both active and pending state unchanged.

method.name: replace_active_branch
method.description: Atomically reconciles only exact tags under a dotted GameplayCue branch (for example [code]GameplayCue.Status[/code] includes [code]GameplayCue.Status.Resolve[/code], but not [code]GameplayCue.StatusExtra[/code]). Accepts an authoritative mapping of in-branch tag names to integer stack counts, with zero removing that cue; missing in-branch cues stop, while unrelated active local or FX cues and transient events remain untouched. Rejects out-of-branch tags, String/StringName aliases, malformed branch names, invalid priorities or stack values, and active/pending capacity overflow without changing state. Uses the same persistent started/updated/stopped semantics as [method replace_active]. A byte-for-byte equivalent active tag set with the same stacks returns true without new pending events, copies, or notifications, even when the pending queue is full. No network authority or gameplay actions are performed; callers provide trustworthy replicated state.

method.name: get_active_snapshot
method.description: Returns an independent mapping of active cue tags to stack counts.

method.name: get_active_stacks
method.description: Returns exact cue stack count, or zero when absent.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Whether the exact cue tag is active.

method.name: take_events
method.description: Drains up to 32 events sorted by descending priority with stable insertion order for ties. Each dictionary includes tag, event, stacks, count, priority and magnitude. Event is one of started/updated/stopped/executed. A zero or negative limit drains nothing.

method.name: get_evicted_transient_count
method.description: Number of low-priority transient events displaced by higher-priority transient events since the last [method reset]. Saturates at the maximum signed 32-bit integer; lifecycle events do not contribute.

method.name: get_rejected_transient_count
method.description: Number of valid transient submissions rejected solely due to full queues with no lower-priority transient victim since the last [method reset]. Invalid inputs do not contribute.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears all active and pending cues without emitting events.
